from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
from tiny_perceptron.model import ModelConfig, TinyLM, generate
from tiny_perceptron.quantization import replace_linear_layers
from torch import nn
import copy
torch.manual_seed(0)
model = TinyLM(ModelConfig(width=8)).eval()
original = model.forward
for cached in (False, True):
    calls = []
    def traced(ids=None, **kwargs):
        cache = kwargs.get("cache")
        calls.append({"input_length":int(ids.shape[1]),"cache_argument_is_none":cache is None})
        return original(ids, **kwargs)
    model.forward = traced
    result = generate(model, torch.tensor([[1,2,3]]), max_new_tokens=3, eos_id=None, use_cache=cached)
    print("GENERATION", cached, json.dumps(calls), result.tolist())
model.forward = original
x = torch.tensor([0.7,0.0,-0.7])
print("DIRECT_CAST", x.to(torch.int8).tolist(), "same_dtype_identity", x.to(x.dtype) is x)
report = json.loads(Path("docs/course-experiments/results/quantization.json").read_text())
config = ModelConfig(**report["results"]["teacher_provenance"]["config"])
model = TinyLM(config).eval()
linear = [(name,layer) for name,layer in model.named_modules() if isinstance(layer, nn.Linear)]
count = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
coeff = sum(layer.weight.numel() for name,layer in linear)
bias = sum(0 if layer.bias is None else layer.bias.numel() for name,layer in linear)
scales = sum(layer.weight.shape[0] for name,layer in linear)
print("MODEL_COUNTS", json.dumps({"parameters":count,"Linear_weights":coeff,"Linear_bias":bias,"retained_nonLinear":count-coeff-bias,"scales":scales,"Linear_modules":len(linear)}))
for bits in (4,8):
    compressed = replace_linear_layers(copy.deepcopy(model), bits)
    actual = sum(p.numel()*p.element_size() for p in compressed.parameters()) + sum(b.numel()*b.element_size() for b in compressed.buffers())
    print("MODEL_STORAGE", bits, actual)
release = json.loads(Path("docs/course-experiments/public-releases/quantization.json").read_text())
manifest = release["release"]["public_manifest"]
inspection = {"immutable_revision":manifest["revision"], "repo":manifest["repo"], "files":[]}
for entry in manifest["files"]:
    if not entry["output"].endswith(".pt"):
        continue
    path = Path("checkpoints/course/quantization") / entry["output"]
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    sha = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    assert sha == entry["sha256"] and len(raw) == entry["bytes"]
    payload = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    tensors = {k:{"shape":list(v.shape),"dtype":str(v.dtype),"elements":v.numel(),"bytes":v.numel()*v.element_size()} for k,v in payload["model"].items()}
    record = {"local_input":str(path),"url":"https://huggingface.co/"+manifest["repo"]+"/resolve/"+manifest["revision"]+"/"+entry["path"],"sha256":sha,"file_bytes":len(raw),"format_version":payload["format_version"],"payload_keys":list(payload),"optimizer_is_none":payload.get("optimizer") is None,"rng_keys":[k for k in payload if "rng" in k.lower()],"config":payload["config"],"tensor_bytes":sum(v["bytes"] for v in tensors.values()),"tensors":tensors}
    inspection["files"].append(record)
    print("PUBLIC_CHECKPOINT", json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k!="tensors"}))
Path("docs/technical-reviews/artifacts/17.1-public-tensors.json").write_text(json.dumps(inspection,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
